summary: A mixed day driven by retail sector momentum and legal precedent on voting rights. Three major retail funding/investment moves total over Rs 1,000 crore, while a Delhi High Court judgment strikes down disenfranchisement as arbitrary.

bullets.text: Justice Ujjal Bhuyan rules disenfranchising millions of Indian citizens intrinsically arbitrary; no justification permits it.
Reliance plans Rs 1 lakh crore investment in Andhra Pradesh, announced by Anant Ambani.
QWEEN, backed by Rosy Blue and Kashikey, secured Rs 1,000 crore investment for expansion targeting Rs 100 crore revenue.
Arvind Fashions arm infuses Rs 50 crore in Flying Machine operator AYBPL; direct shareholding falls to 34.09% from 39.60%.
Consumer, home and wellness businesses raised over Rs 175 crore in disclosed funding this week, led by home interiors platform Gravity.
